invalidation: Demote if win rate is below 40% over 15 trades or profit factor below 1.0 over 20.
name: VWAP Extreme Fade

provenance.note: Corrected port of eval_vwap_fade. The legacy version computes `vw = anchored_vwap(df, anchor)` as a SCALAR and divides the whole close series by it, so the constant cancels out of the z-score and its 'VWAP deviation z-score' is arithmetically just a z-score of price. This spec uses the rolling VWAP at each bar, so it measures the deviation it claims to. Bar agreement 0.972 against the legacy signal is that correction.

thesis: Without a trend regime, extensions beyond roughly 2.5 sigma from the anchored VWAP revert as liquidity providers are paid the panic premium of overreaction traders (De Bondt-Thaler).
